Social media post: "heard the Agalawatta tower is already fixed, the company van came" (unconfirmed).
NMS 06:00 | MAJOR | AGA19 Agalawatta | AC MAINS FAIL, running on battery bank

finding.finding: Verified: Agalawatta (S05) has no grid power. No equipment condition is stated.

S05 is the only resolved fault: grid power is verified false; equipment is healthy. GEN-G1-S05 is catalogued and reachable from DEPOT via R18. G1 is available with fuel capacity 150, but no crew is shown at DEPOT with a confirmed route/time feasibility for all work, and the generator's duration/fuel-use semantics are unspecified. No evidence establishes an unsafe or impossible action, so no defer request is warranted.

questions.question: Please confirm the generator's operational duration/fuel-use interpretation and whether its listed fuel capacity supports the intended temporary-power deployment at S05.

finding.finding: S05 (Agalawatta) is the only service with a confirmed current outage: its equipment is working, but grid power has failed. Its approved critical weight is 5, so this outage matters most. The remaining services have approved weight 1 and no outage is established for them. Reports about Negombo do not establish an asset condition, the Nugegoda notice is for a future planned interruption, and the Agalawatta repair claim is unconfirmed; none changes current priorities.

findings: V2-03-OBS-01 supports the verified fact that S05 (Agalawatta, AGA19) has grid power unavailable; it does not claim equipment failure.

The deployment route DEPOT → S04 → S05 is consistent with the directory. Travel takes 15 minutes; departure at 0 and work start at 15 are consistent. A 10-minute duration gives the recorded work end at 25.
